text: Managing a team is a challenging but rewarding responsibility. Good communication is the foundation of success, so leaders should share information clearly and listen to their team members. Delegation is also important; trusting people with tasks helps them grow and prevents the leader from becoming overloaded. Regular feedback, both positive and constructive, keeps everyone moving in the right direction. To maintain motivation, managers should recognise achievements and support professional development. Finally, conflict resolution skills are essential, because disagreements will always happen. A good leader addresses problems early and fairly, helping the team stay focused, united and productive.
